The '''FA-1 Command Walker''' was a type of one-man two-legged [[Walker/Legends|walker]] that was available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
